establishment.name: SANTINI'S NEW YORK STYLE DELI - RESTON

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed no hand soap at the hand sink in the dish washing area
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC REFILLED THE SOAP DISPENSER

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) Raw ground beef was observed being stored over lettuce in the walk-in cooler 2) Raw chicken was observed being stored on top of a bucket of hard boiled eggs in the walk-in cooler
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED ALL THE OF THE RAW MEATS TO THE RAW MEAT SHELF.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Observed staff move cooked pizza with his bare hands onto a tray and to put it on the speed rack
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. PIZZA WAS DISCARDED. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF MEMBER TO WEAR GLOVES WHEN HANDLING COOKED PIZZA.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The hand sinks at the 3 compartment sink and the entrance to the kitchen were observed at 88f
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. ALL HAND SINKS MUST BE AT LEAST 100f. ADDRESS THIS ISSUE BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated

violations.title: Safe, Unadulterated & Honestly Presented
violations.observation: The following food item(s) is observed to be unsound or adulterated: 1) spinach in the pizza prep top observed to be slimy and discolored
violations.corrective_action: ALL food shall be safe, unadulterated and honestly presented as specified under 3-601.12. PIC DISCARDED THE FOOD. SANTINI'S NEW YORK STYLE DELI - RESTON (Inspection Date: 01/02/2026) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) chili was observed at 133f
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC REHEATED THE CHILI ON THE STOVE TO 165f. CHILI WAS PUT BACK INTO THE STEAM TABLE.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 3DR prep top cooler in the kitchen; cooked chicken (46f); sliced cheese (43f); cannoli cream (43f). Upon discussion with PIC, cooked chicken was placed in the top of the prep top unit 3 hours prior to inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE CHEESE AND THE CANNOLI CREAM. PIC AGREED TO DISCARD THE CHICKEN IN 1 HOUR.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: Observed multiple food storage containers of cut tomatoes, shredded lettuce, pickles, olives, and onions without any date marking.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC THAT ALL FOODS THAT IS TO BE STORED FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS NEED TO BE DATE MARKED. USE OR DISCARD WITHIN 7 DAYS.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: PIC could not produce a food probe thermometer.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. PURCHASE A FOOD PROBE THERMOMETER BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The hot water at the 3 compartment sink was observed at 87f
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. HOT WATER AT THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK MUST BE AT LEAST 110f. INCREASE THE TEMPERATURE BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Equipment Clean to Sight and Touch
violations.observation: Encrusted grease deposits and/or other soil deposits were observed on the food contact surfaces of the following cooking equipment: 1) exterior of all of the prep coolers in the kitchen; 2) the non-food contact surfaces of the meat slicers.
violations.corrective_action: The food-contact surfaces of cooking equipment and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. MORE FREQUENT CLEANING IS REQUIRED.

out_items.name: Hot and cold water available, adequate pressure

violations.title: Hot Water Capacity to Meet Peak Demands
violations.observation: The permit holder has removed the water heater previously approved by the Health Department. The new water heater (AO Smith AT-H3-DV-N) does not have the capacity to meet the hourly peak hot water demands of the food establishment. The minimum peak hot water demand is 6.0 gpm at a 80f rise for the use of four handsinks, one 3-compartment sink, one prep sink, and one mop sink. The current peak hot water demand is 4.75 gpm resulting in a 20.8% deficiency.
violations.corrective_action: Within 30 days, the permit holder shall replace or upgrade the water heater with a unit that meets the following design and capacity requirements: (1) Commercial grade, (2) Minimum of 50 gallon storage tank, (3) Minimum recovery rate of @gph of ##F water at a ##F rise@, and (4) Specifications and installation meet National Sanitation Foundation (NSF) Standard 5. The permit holder shall provide the Health Department with the specifications (cut sheet) for the replacement water heater and obtain approval prior to purchase and installation. Please be reminded that equipment replacement or addition is not allowed without prior approval by the Health Department. INSTALL ANOTHER TANKLESS WATER HEART OF THE SAME MAKE AND MODEL IN PARALLEL TO THE EXISTING ONE.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed large holes in the wall next to the tankless water heater. Holes were covered with cardboard, plastic bags, and a sheet tray. Observed holes in the ceiling around the water heater.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PROPERLY REPAIR THESE HOLES.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed no paper towels at the handsink next to the 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. MANAGEMENT PLACED PAPER TOWELS AT THE HAND SINK.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed no hand washing sign at the handsink next sink to the kitchen doorway
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS PROVIDED MANAGEMENT WITH A HANDWASHING SIGN TO POST.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Observed Raw ground beef being stored above Ready-to-Eat food in the 3DR prep top in the kitchen. Observed Raw chicken breast being stored above Ready-to- Eat food in the walk-in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. MANAGEMENT MOVED THE RAW PROTEINS TO THE BOTTOM SHELVES AND PUT THE READY-TO-EAT FOOD ABOVE THE RAW PROTEINS.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed food being stored directly on the floor of the walk-in cooler and walk-in freezer
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. ELEVATE ALL FOOD OFF THE FLOOR TO FACILITATE PROPER CLEANING. USE NSF APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Observed a knife being stored in a small gap between prep top coolers.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. MANAGEMENT MOVED THE KNIFE. DO NOT STORE UTENSILS/KNIVES IN SMALL GAPS. THESE AREAS CANNOT BE CLEANED AND SANITIZED.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Equipment Clean to Sight and Touch
violations.observation: Observed the exterior of coolers, including cooler doors and door handles, with an accumulation of food debris.
violations.corrective_action: The food-contact surfaces of cooking equipment and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. PLEASE CLEAN THE EXTERIOR OF ALL COOLERS. ROUTINE CLEANING IS REQUIRED.
